coverage_note: Opened and read all 4 assigned pages and all 52 assigned items in full, plus the statements (and, where a claim turned on a clause, the proof sections) of ~110 dependency items, recomputing the norm, series, integral and witness computations independently. Repaired confirmed defects only inside in-flight items of this batch: two proof-step defects (thm-inverse-function-theorem-for-banach-spaces step 9.1: the constructed U_0=a+W was not a neighbourhood of a; lem-local-finite-dimensional-reduction-for-a-fredholm-map step 5.1: T_0 needed the constraint u in B for the uniqueness of the implicit function theorem to give injectivity), four ill-formed or mislabelled clauses (def-absolute-value-and-singular-values-of-a-compact-operator 'Rank and the finiteness' sentence; thm-singular-value-decomposition-for-compact-operators [A1]; thm-trace-class-is-a-two-sided-banach-operator-ideal [A1]; cex-trace-of-products-is-not-cyclic-without-summability step 1.1; ex-a-projection-with-finite-dimensional-kernel-is-fredholm statement), one typo (Hilber-Schmidt), and one missing pipeline_run frontmatter line (lem-nuclear-series-characterizes-trace-norm); the batch proof contract's step-9-1, step-10-1 and step-5-1 derivations were updated to match. No batch item carried a verification.judge record, so none was removed. After the repairs, reflow reported no change, precheck passed on all 52 items (40 checked, 0 failing), proof-contract --strict passed (0 errors, 0 warnings, 52/52), citation-fidelity found no missing quote or widening candidate, and rendercheck passed on all nine changed items. Honest limitations: I did not re-prove end to end the internal arguments of every upstream dependency (e.g. the contraction iteration of thm-banach-fixed-point, the L^2-kernel/Tonelli development), I did not run the library renderer or the Step 5b cross-group closures, and the Hermitian boundary clause of ex-integral-operator-trace-under-a-valid-diagonal-hypothesis was verified only by combining the classical Carleman theorem as quoted in Jefferies' ANU note with an elementary even/odd parity argument; that external support is not cited inside the item, and no non-repository source other than the two recorded in the report was read. Nothing remained uneditable, hence the empty findings array.
